verdict.rationale: Honcho is a memory layer for AI agents, so memory expiry or decay is an applicable axis. Nothing in the evidence pack documents TTLs, expiration dates, or recency-weighted decay of memories. Retrieval-shaping controls (search, token budgets, summaries, peer scoping) and opt-in Dreamer working memory are related features, not a way to make stale facts stop surfacing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can make memories expire or decay — via TTL, expiration dates, or recency weighting — so stale facts stop surfacing
